title: Roamhaven Rewards Benefit Note — Arrival-Night Courtesy on a Fee Refund
content:
# Roamhaven Rewards benefit note — arrival-night courtesy on the guest service fee refund

**Benefit.** Roamhaven Rewards members who leave a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category on the day they arrive get a courtesy on the arrival night, whose price is the nightly subtotal divided by the stay's nights rounded half up to the cent:

- when the cancellation is dated on the check-in date and the guest's active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes a dedicated concierge, 100 percent of the arrival night's price is added to the fee base of the refund;
- when the cancellation is dated on the check-in date and the guest's active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes the priority support line but no dedicated concierge, 50 percent of it is added;
- otherwise none of it is added.

The courtesy amount is rounded half up to the cent and is returned in full. The guest's Roamhaven Rewards membership on record — its tier, that tier's features and whether it is active — decides which line applies.

## Cases (hypothetical stay, nightly subtotal 900.00 over 5 nights, arrival night 180.00)

| Cancellation dated | Membership | Added to the fee base of the refund |
|---|---|---|
| the check-in date | active, dedicated concierge | 180.00 |
| the check-in date | active, priority support line only | 90.00 |
| the check-in date | no active membership | 0.00 |
| the day after check-in | active, dedicated concierge | 0.00 |
| the day before check-in | active, dedicated concierge | 0.00 |

At a fee percentage of 14.20%, an added 180.00 adds 25.56 to the fee refund, and an added 90.00 adds 12.78.
